title: Monster
description: A monster that players encounter during boss fights (merged PRs)

description.description: Flavor text — give your monster personality

difficulty.description: Difficulty tier — determines when this monster appears

hp.description: Hit points the player must deplete to win

attack.description: Damage dealt to the player per round

xp_reward.description: XP awarded for defeating this monster

drop.description: Name of the item this monster can drop (must match an item file)

drop_chance.description: Probability of dropping the item (0.0 to 1.0)
